title: Entitled Brat Catches Felony on Birthday Night
description:
At around midnight, Florida officers received a confusing 911 call regarding an altercation at a bar. Officers reached the bar and helped clear out the crowd but one of the women who was involved in the earlier altercation couldn’t find her Android and refused to leave. The phone was nowhere to be found much like the manners on this brat especially on her birthday. While these officers were searching the female, the backup officers had some simple fun by bothering a couple who were engaging in PDA. The female ultimately refused to identify herself and was booked as Jane Doe until her identity was confirmed by fingerprinting. She was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer and resisting arrest and her bond was set at $1500.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
